description:
Several cited facts for one country in one call: power, currency, emergency numbers, driving side, this year's public holidays, tipping (data.<category>.<field>; a category without data is {}). Use it for a country overview. For one topic use get_emergency_numbers, get_tipping_norms, get_public_holidays (any dates) or check_power_compatibility (adapter verdict); for a whole trip get_trip_brief; for visas check_entry_requirements. Each fact is cited: sources[] (url, license), last_verified, confidence.
Parameters: alpha-2 country codes work best (alpha-3 too; names via resolve_country). Request only the categories you need to keep the answer small. Examples: {"country":"JP"}, {"country":"FRA","categories":["power","currency"]}.
Read-only; keyless (free key or x402 lifts limits: https://citedtravel.com/pricing/); errors RFC 9457.

categories.description: Categories to return; omit for all six.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, case-insensitive (e.g. JP, jp or JPN). Names are not accepted: resolve them with resolve_country first.

lang.description: Language for localized names (BCP 47). Supported: en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; aliases such as zh, zh-CN, zh-TW and zh-HK are mapped, and anything else falls back to English. Only names are localized; verbatim official quotes stay in their original language.
